policies.text: An enterprise is granted approval for Tier-1 Freight Coverage if its mean vehicle fleet age remains under 4 years, or if it maintains active ISO 22000 certification.
A logistics firm secures Executive Vendor Status provided its annual billing exceeds 5 million dollars or it operates across four international regions.
An applicant approved for Tier-1 Freight Coverage receives automatic rate discounting across commercial fleet insurance.
Participation in Same-Day Heavy Cargo is granted to any transport firm maintaining an active fleet of at least 10 heavy transport vans.
An applicant qualifies for Hazardous Materials Clearance if it maintains specialized spill containment kits and holds a valid ISO 14001 environmental management credential.
